honing_confound: Mayhem path unlocks via Ark Passive Enlightenment at IL 1100. Tier standing claims reflect IL-gated access; damage numbers reflect T4 gear honing ceiling. IL-gated identity is a confound dimension on top of honing economy.

delivery.evidence: All primary skills (Finish Strike, Hell Blade, Sword Storm, Tempest Slash, Overdrive) are melee sword attacks. Dark Rush (identity-mode skill) is a targeted dash-strike at melee range. No projectile emission from caster.

footprint.evidence: Most skills hit in a small directional arc or cone in front of the caster. Sword Storm is the widest AoE (360 spin). Tempest Slash creates a wider cone. Finish Strike is a narrow frontal cone. All within melee engagement range (~3-6m).

geo_text: Melee-only kit. Berserker attacks in close range with large sword sweeps; most skills are frontal cones or 360 spins within arm's reach. No ranged output. Back-attack positioning (+10% crit +5% dmg) required on key skills — delivery is directional from caster's melee range.

control.evidence: Berserker's kit is damage-focused; no prominent hard CC (stun, freeze, knockback as primary identity). Finish Strike and some skills inflict Stagger (LA's boss-phase mechanic). Mayhem grants push immunity to the caster. Caster is not a controller.

defense.evidence: Mayhem permanently locks HP at 25% max. Incoming damage reduced 72% and -60% healing received/-75% shielding received. Effective HP is very low despite reduction. Dark Rush grants brief super armor. Identity is high-risk-high-reward (glass with damage-reduction trade-off, not true tankiness).

economy.resource_verbatim: Fury Meter (red bar; fills via attacks)
economy.builder_source: All attacks generate Fury passively; some skills generate more. Mayhem: once Fury fills and Z is activated, Burst Mode becomes PERMANENT (no exhaustion timer) — the meter is effectively always full in Mayhem identity. Identity converts Burst Mode to a toggle state at cost of HP lock.
economy.plain_text: Fury Meter fills from attacking. In Mayhem, activating Burst Mode (Z) permanently locks it on — no cycling, no exhaustion, no re-charge. Health is hard-locked at 25% for the duration of combat. This removes the resource management loop and replaces it with a HP-floor tradeoff.

element.evidence: Berserker skills deal Physical damage primarily. Mayhem mode converts some skills to Dark-attribute damage (source: skill descriptions pre-Ark Passive; exact damage type in current Ark Passive system not independently verified from live sources, conf reduced to 0.8).

movement.evidence: Most Berserker skills root the caster during animation. Bloody Rush is a dash. Mayhem grants +15% movement and attack speed but does not grant free-movement during skill casts. 'Poor mobility' noted in Maxroll guide. Some skills have built-in movement as part of animation (charging swing) but the caster is committed during animation.

attr.evidence: Melee-only. Back-attack positional requirement on multiple skills.

range.evidence: All skills land at melee engagement distance. No ranged output.

tempo.evidence: Mayhem is the sustained identity: no burst window, no downtime, permanent Burst Mode. Damage is consistent rather than spike. Contrast with Berserker's Technique (burst).

amp.value: permanent +18% dmg / +15% atk+mv speed / +30% crit rate / +72% dmg reduction while in Burst Mode (which is permanent in Mayhem)
amp.evidence: Maxroll guide: Mayhem grants 18% Damage Increase, 15% Attack and Movement Speed Increase, 72% Damage Reduction, 30% Crit Rate in Burst Mode. Mayhem makes Burst Mode permanent.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics (summons, turrets, remote detonations). All damage is direct melee output.

commitment.evidence: Major damage skills (Finish Strike, Seismic Hammer, Overdrive) have wind-up animations. Bloody Rush is closer to instant (dash-initiate). Mayhem grants push immunity/super armor to sustain through animations.

mechanics_notes: 1) Mayhem is the most 'berserker' identity in genre terms: permanent HP-floor trade for sustained damage amplification. No build-release rhythm — identity is a binary state switch. 2) Dark Rush (identity skill within Mayhem mode) becomes a major damage contributor via Ark Grid synergy — this is a post-Ark-Passive mechanic; specifics of Ark Grid system not fully sourced from live URLs. 3) Red Dust self-buff (8-second window for maximizing output) is a skill-rotation anchor — not a meter system but a cooldown-anchored burst phase within the sustained identity. 4) Stagger contribution: multiple Berserker skills have Stagger ratings; this feeds LA's boss stagger-bar mechanic (no engine equivalent — mechanics-gap item). 5) Animation cancel via spacebar (LA movement mechanic) used to truncate slow swing animations; not representable in kit schema.
engraving_debut: Global launch 2022 (both engravings available at launch)
stabilization_patch: Pre-Ark Passive: Mayhem was dominant from early global through 2024. Post-Ark Passive (Feb 2025): identity preserved as Enlightenment path.
tier_standing_release: A-tier at global launch (strong but not top)
tier_standing_current: B-tier (Maxroll community tier list, mid-2025 to early 2026); lower tier due to positional difficulty penalty in modern raid design. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: B-tier reflects T4 honing ceiling meta where other classes outscale. Mayhem is a teaching archetype — the permanent-Burst tradeoff is mechanically simpler than BT but punished by positional difficulty.

honing_confound: BT identity is IL-gated at Enlightenment unlock threshold (IL 1100). Burst window timing and damage output both scale with honing tier. Tier standing in BT reflects meta at T4 ceiling — less honing-sensitive than Mayhem on relative terms (BT is underused in current meta per sources) but confound applies to damage claims.

delivery.evidence: Same skill pool as Mayhem Berserker; all melee. Bloody Rush (dash-in), Overdrive, Finish Strike, Hell Blade, Tempest Slash, Wind Blade. Wind Blade is the primary Fury generator — long frontal sweep.

footprint.evidence: Same melee cone/arc footprint as Mayhem. Burst Mode skills emphasize forward-facing damage arcs. Slightly more directional discipline required vs Mayhem (slower charge skills = more commitment to position).

geo_text: Melee-only, same spatial profile as Mayhem Berserker. Key distinction: BT rotates through a BUILD (fill Fury via Wind Blade + normals) → BURST (activate Z, spend 30 seconds with +36% damage / +30% crit / +20% atk speed) → EXHAUSTION (exit Burst, recover). All phases are melee. Exhaustion phase has no penalty beyond meter depletion — re-entry is as fast as Fury rebuilds.

control.evidence: Same as Mayhem: no hard CC as identity feature. Stagger contribution on key skills. BT's slower charge skills (Specialization stat focus) hit harder but have same CC profile.

defense.evidence: BT does NOT lock HP at 25% — this is the key defensive contrast vs Mayhem. Full HP available. Defense comes from super armor during Burst Mode and standard tankiness for a heavy warrior. Push immunity during 2.5s Burst Mode activation window. BT Berserker has meaningfully higher effective HP than Mayhem — trades sustained damage for survivability.

economy.resource_verbatim: Fury Meter (red bar; fills via attacks; depletes over 30s in Burst Mode)
economy.builder_source: Wind Blade (primary Fury generator; high Fury generation per cast). Brave Slash + Tempest Slash also generate Fury as secondary contributors. Standard attacks generate Fury passively.
economy.plain_text: BUILD PHASE: Use Wind Blade + support skills to fill Fury Meter. BURST PHASE: Activate Z — Burst Mode grants +36% damage, +30% crit rate, +20% atk/mv speed for 30 seconds. No exhaustion on exit. Re-enter as soon as Fury fills again. BT has 3 Gravity Core equivalent phases in its loop but via a simple fill-and-activate structure. BT does NOT use a Gravity Core system — this is Berserker's system, distinct from Destroyer's.

element.evidence: Same as Mayhem; Physical damage type. BT uses Specialization stat (vs Mayhem's Crit) — affects stat distribution not damage element.

movement.evidence: Same poor mobility profile. Wind Blade (primary generator) is a rooted channeled swing. BT emphasizes 'slow charge skills' per Maxroll guide — more rooted commitment during skill animations than Mayhem.

range.evidence: All melee range. Wind Blade has longer frontal reach than some Mayhem skills but still melee.

tempo.evidence: BT is the burst identity: build Fury → enter 30s Burst window → exit → repeat. Damage is concentrated in Burst windows. Contrast with Mayhem (sustained).

amp.value: Burst Mode: +36% damage / +20% atk+mv speed / +30% crit rate for 30-second window
amp.evidence: Maxroll guide: Berserker's Technique Burst grants 36% Damage Increase (higher than Mayhem's 18% because health is not locked). Exit without exhaustion = fast re-entry.

commitment.evidence: BT specifically emphasizes 'slow charge skills' — Specialization stat focus means longer animations than Mayhem's speed-focused build. Wind Blade is a slow frontal sweep requiring positioning discipline.

mechanics_notes: 1) BT is the LESS popular identity in current (2025-2026) meta per Maxroll — Mayhem's simplicity + permanent damage bonus is preferred. BT requires more precise Fury management and position discipline for the burst window. 2) No exhaustion on Burst Mode exit is a significant quality-of-life difference vs. older Berserker designs — this was a rework. 3) BT uses Specialization stat to improve Burst Mode damage — this stat affects skill charge/cast speed and awakening skill damage in LA. The Specialization dependency is an identity-layer on top of the mechanic. 4) Wind Blade as dedicated generator is the clearest builder/spender articulation in Berserker's economy; Mayhem has no such discrete builder (everything generates passively). This builder/spender contrast is the cleanest engine-analogy for Berserker BT.
stabilization_patch: BT was favored meta early in 2022 global; Mayhem surpassed it by mid-2022 and has been dominant since. BT stabilized as the 'alternative' identity.
tier_standing_current: C-tier or lower (community tier lists 2025-2026; significantly outperformed by Mayhem in T4 meta). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: BT tier standing in T4 reflects gear-ceiling meta where Mayhem's consistent DPS output outperforms BT's burst windows — confound applies directly.
